title: Recht-Ré conjecture with norms inside the sums
statement:
Let $A_1,\dots,A_n$ be positive semidefinite matrices, and let $\lVert\,\cdot\,\rVert$ denote the matrix norm used in the conjecture. For ordered products of length $m$, distinguish sums over all index tuples from sums over tuples with distinct indices. **Norm-sum Recht-Ré conjecture.**

$$
\frac{1}{n^m}\sum_{1\leq j_1,\dots,j_m\leq n}\lVert A_{j_1}\cdots A_{j_m}\rVert\geq\frac{(n-m)!}{n!}\sum_{\substack{1\leq j_1,\dots,j_m\leq n,\\j_1,\dots,j_m\ \text{distinct}}}\lVert A_{j_1}\cdots A_{j_m}\rVert.
$$

This is a related conjecture attributed to Recht and Ré, with the norms taken termwise rather than after summation. The source does not state whether it has been resolved.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2006.01510

Status: **open** according to the source (as of June 2020). “We conclude our article with a discussion of some open problems and why we think the Recht--R\'e conjecture, while false as it is currently stated, only needs to be refined.”
source_name: Zehua Lai and Lek-Heng Lim, “Recht-Ré Noncommutative Arithmetic-Geometric Mean Conjecture is False”, arXiv:2006.01510 (2020).
